headline: OmniVoice Studio: Open-Source ElevenLabs Alternative for macOS
summary: OmniVoice Studio offers ElevenLabs-level capabilities running 100% on your machine, eliminating cloud reliance and subscription fees. It supports 646 languages and 14 TTS engines.
details: OmniVoice Studio is a new open-source desktop application for macOS, positioning itself as a local alternative to ElevenLabs. It eliminates monthly fees, API keys, and cloud processing by running all AI audio tasks directly on your machine.

Developed by debpalash, the AGPL-3.0 licensed app integrates various AI audio functionalities into one tool. MarkTechPost has highlighted it as a significant local, open-source alternative for AI audio generation.

Key features include zero-shot voice cloning from just 3 seconds of audio, supporting 646 languages. Users can also fine-tune parameters like gender, age, accent, pitch, speed, and emotion without needing to clone a specific voice.

The studio offers a comprehensive audio pipeline: import YouTube URLs or video files for transcription via WhisperX, translation, and new voice synthesis, exporting directly to MP4. It also supports importing text, EPUB, or PDF files for audiobook creation, including automatic chapter splitting and metadata.

Advanced capabilities include assigning unique voices to multiple characters for full-cast audio stories and a system-wide widget for real-time transcription via WebSocket. It also features a built-in MCP Server for TTS/STT calls from other clients.

The platform is hardware-agnostic, not tied to a single engine, and offers 14 different TTS engines, with the primary OmniVoice engine from k2-fsa supporting over 600 languages. Engines are lazy-registered, installing only upon first use.

A notable limitation is the lack of support for Intel Macs, as PyTorch has ceased x86_64 support for macOS. While technically supporting Thai, the quality remains unbenchmarked, with community fine-tunes still having limited training data compared to commercial solutions.

With over 8,300 GitHub stars and daily updates, OmniVoice Studio stands out as a leading open-source ElevenLabs alternative. Its commitment to local processing and extensive language/engine support makes it a compelling choice for AI audio users on Apple Silicon.

headline_marked: [[Gemini handles 6 Google Sheets jobs]] for expert, saving hours of manual work
headline: Gemini handles 6 Google Sheets jobs for expert, saving hours of manual work
summary: Google's Gemini AI, integrated with Google Sheets, is automating complex tasks like data cleanup, formatting, and formula generation, significantly reducing manual effort for users.
details: Gemini's integration with Google Sheets is automating tasks, with the AI scoring 70.48% on SpreadsheetBench V1 - Full. This indicates near human-expert level, though it may still miss about three out of ten tasks.

Starting a sheet from scratch is now easier as Gemini can build a full base with headers and placeholder data from a single prompt. This eliminates the initial blank page problem, though users should monitor for overcomplication.

Raw data exports can be cleaned efficiently by Gemini, which standardizes names to Title Case and removes duplicate entries. However, users must carefully check for regional date format misinterpretations.

Conditional formatting, often hidden behind nested menus, can be applied by Gemini from a single prompt. It can add status dropdowns and highlight rows, but blank cells may confuse the AI without specific rules.

Gemini can write complex formulas, like INDEX/MATCH, and explain its logic, reducing the need to search for syntax. Users should still double-check for missing dollar signs in ranges, which can cause formulas to break.
A dedicated formula troubleshooter now reads broken formulas and neighboring cells to pinpoint errors. This recent upgrade helps fix common issues like #REF and #N/A errors in inherited spreadsheets.

For data analysis, Gemini can identify trends, build summary dashboards, and create visuals from scattered data. While powerful, it's crucial to double-check any figures before sharing with stakeholders.

Ultimately, Gemini acts as a "very good intern," removing about 70% of the friction in spreadsheet work. This buys back significant time, allowing users to focus on data analysis rather than manual preparation.
